objective: Keep Main BUKLOD login responsive and accurately recover an authenticated profile under weak/intermittent signal without reducing authentication or onboarding security.
productionBaselineEvidence: Source-only: exact frozen cumulative RC head 543c36245717cf77d4c8bc614609fc2fe91b3ef4 and main d23cd882f7d34c4bca3a110dadd04ee4cb2240a9 inspected on 2026-11-18; no live device, Supabase runtime, staged OTA or AdMob fill verified.
chosenApproach: Preserve Supabase password grant and server account-status RPC; identify confirmed profile-not-found separately from transient/offline remote lookup, show safe cached same-user profile or an actionable connection state, and show progress while waiting without any new network calls.
selectionRationale: Login already has bounded 24-second single-flight password transport, local session restore and lifecycle verification. Removing those checks creates auth risks. Source inspection found profile read errors indistinguishable from first-time onboarding, so repair that behavior with account-scoped state and clear progress.
alternativeApproaches: Skip lifecycle/RLS checks to render dashboard immediately (rejected: security regression and deactivated-account access).
Repeat password logins in the background under weak signal (rejected: duplicate grants, rate limits and refresh-token races).
Replace Supabase auth with an unverified cached JWT online (rejected: expired/invalid session reuse).
preserveBehaviors: Account status RPC, self-deactivation, Supabase auth and mandatory consent gating remain authoritative.
Offline identity only uses existing restricted policy; never unlock unauthenticated online API access.
Switching accounts cannot render prior account profile or roles from late network callbacks.
No changes to ad placements, ad prefetch, dashboard navigation animation, Wall, Connect, points, backend schema, EAS package or native runtime.
acceptanceChecks: Profile timeout/offline/degraded is distinguishable from confirmed PGRST116 absent profile.
A true newly registered profile-missing case still opens normal onboarding.
Cached profile belongs to the current authenticated user; old account network results cannot replace a new account.
Long network wait shows a progress message; does not duplicate password grants or cancel account-status verification.
Run TS typecheck, focused Node test, existing auth/consent/navigation/AdMob regression tests and exact-head Engineering Accountability.
No staging/production OTA without compatibility, artifact, served manifest and mandatory ads/navigation gates.
